annual.note: FY ends Oct 31 2025. Revenue and operating income are as filed (continuing operations); the Spirent acquisition closed Oct 15 2025 and OSG Oct 17 2025, so FY2025 contains only ~2 weeks of Spirent and OSG (Spirent revenue since acquisition $9m). Spirent was paid for in cash ($1,415m net of cash acquired, $1,564m total consideration) from existing cash, not debt; the 4 senior notes ($2,550m face) are unchanged. Spirent high-speed-ethernet/network-security/channel-emulation lines were sold to Viavi on Oct 16 2025 for $399m (discontinued operations, net loss $19m, outside operating income). Restricted cash of $17m is excluded from cash. Long-term investments $211m are balance-sheet total (equity investments, deferred-comp earmarked securities and non-readily-determinable investments); the research package excludes them from its capital bridge. Shares are derived from the statement of equity at Oct 31 2025 (issued less treasury); the 10-K cover count is dated Dec 12 2025. No stock options are disclosed as outstanding. Unvested RSUs include LTP performance shares as reported in the same table.

ttm.note: Latest filed quarterly report on or before 2026-10-21 is the Q3 FY2026 10-Q (period Jul 31 2026, filed 2026-09-02); the Q4/FY2026 10-K is not yet filed. 9M comparatives are as presented in that 10-Q (matches the originally filed Q3 FY2025 10-Q: revenue 3,956, operating income 659). TTM includes ~9.5 months of Spirent and OSG (closed Oct 15/17 2025), so TTM flows are a different perimeter from FY2025 flows; Spirent contributed incremental revenue of $204m in 9M FY2026. Nine-month operating income includes the IEEPA tariff refund benefit ($93m to cost of sales, $4m to SG&A) and a $40m customer surcharge refund reducing revenue, and $75m acquisition/integration costs. Shares: the dated-at-period-end count is derived from the statement of equity (170.298m at Jul 31 2026); the 10-Q cover count of 170.244745m is dated Aug 27 2026 (27-day mismatch in the research package) and is reported only for reference. The $700m 4.60% 2027 notes are now current; $600m of 2034 notes are swapped fixed-to-floating ($20m fair-value adjustment reduces carrying value; face total $2,550m). $750m revolver (Apr 21 2026, expires Apr 2031) undrawn. Total debt carrying $2,517m vs face $2,550m. Long-term investments $188m not netted by the research package. No stock options disclosed.

Spirent (closed 2025-10-15) was financed with cash, not debt; the 4 senior notes are unchanged. FY2025 operating income barely includes Spirent/OSG; TTM includes ~9.5 months, so the two bases differ in perimeter.
Unvested RSUs/performance shares at Jul 31 2026 are not disclosed in the 10-Q; the Oct 31 2025 figure (2.362m) is carried. No options outstanding are disclosed.
